title: media.manifest_finalized.v1
description: Every track for a session is uploaded, aligned and durable. Evaluation waits for this rather than for session completion, because a session ends before its media has finished arriving and evaluating from partial media is how a candidate is judged on what was recorded rather than on what they said.

track_count.description: How many tracks. A count below what the session expected means media is missing, which a consumer must treat as insufficient rather than as complete.

checksum.description: Of the manifest, so a replay can prove it read the same media.
